name: FMC For Cancer Reigate 2026
information:
Please read all the information in the **FAQ** and the **Important Information** tabs before registering.

**Spectators may attend for free. There is no need to book!**

**Proceeds from this competition will be donated to [Cancer Research UK](https://www.cancerresearchuk.org/), which funds research into treatments for cancer which will affect 1 in 3 people. Your participation in this competition could be saving lives!**
